# `hex`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Converts `expr` to hexadecimal.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
hex(expr)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `math_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- hex, example 1
> SELECT hex(17);
11
```

```sql
-- hex, example 2
> SELECT hex('Spark SQL');
537061726B2053514C
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 1.5.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
